name: Benvolio Montague
original_name: ベンヴォーリオ＝モンタギュー
source:
A relative of [url=/c12547]Romeo's[/url].
A vampire that wants to reconcile with the humans.
After a long time wandering other countries he has finally come back to Verona.
He's cooperating with [url=/c12551]Escalus[/url] on his reconciliation plan.
